verses.text: On the first day of the seventh month, have a holy gathering and do no regular work. It is a day for you to blow the trumpets.
Bring a burnt offering as a smell that pleases the LORD: one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With them bring a grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: about four and a half kilograms with the bull, about three kilograms with the ram,
and about one and a half kilograms with each of the seven lambs.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering to make you right with God.

These are in addition to the burnt offering for the new month with its grain offering, and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, as the rules say. They are a gift made by fire, a smell that pleases the LORD.
On the tenth day of this seventh month, have a holy gathering. Go without food and do no work at all.
Bring the LORD a burnt offering as a smell that pleases him: one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With them bring a grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: about four and a half kilograms with the bull, about three kilograms with the ram,
and about one and a half kilograms with each of the seven lambs.

Also bring one male goat as a sin offering. These are in addition to the sin offering for making the people right with God, and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, have a holy gathering and do no regular work. Celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days.
Bring a burnt offering, a gift made by fire with a smell that pleases the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With them bring a grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: about four and a half kilograms with each of the thirteen bulls, about three kilograms with each of the two rams,
and about one and a half kilograms with each of the fourteen lambs.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering. These are in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
On the second day, offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With the bulls, rams, and lambs, bring their grain offerings and drink offerings, the right amount for the number of animals, as the rules say.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
On the third day, offer eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With the bulls, rams, and lambs, bring their grain offerings and drink offerings, the right amount for the number of animals, as the rules say.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
On the fourth day, offer ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With the bulls, rams, and lambs, bring their grain offerings and drink offerings, the right amount for the number of animals, as the rules say.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
On the fifth day, offer nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With the bulls, rams, and lambs, bring their grain offerings and drink offerings, the right amount for the number of animals, as the rules say.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
On the sixth day, offer eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With the bulls, rams, and lambs, bring their grain offerings and drink offerings, the right amount for the number of animals, as the rules say.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
On the seventh day, offer seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With the bulls, rams, and lambs, bring their grain offerings and drink offerings, the right amount for the number of animals, as the rules say.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
On the eighth day, have a special gathering and do no regular work.
Bring a burnt offering, a gift made by fire with a smell that pleases the LORD: one bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with nothing wrong with them.
With the bull, the ram, and the lambs, bring their grain offerings and drink offerings, the right amount for the number of animals, as the rules say.
Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

Offer these to the LORD at your special feasts. They are in addition to the offerings you bring to keep a promise and your freely given gifts, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings."
Moses told the people of Israel everything the LORD had commanded him.
